description: Restore the accidentally deleted artifact 'commons-lang3-3.14.0.jar' from the Artifactory Trash Can. The artifact belongs to the 'example-repo-local' repository. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to the Administration module, find the Trash Can, locate the deleted file, and restore it to its original path. Verify the restoration by confirming the artifact appears back in the Artifacts browser.
